name: The Third Account
source:
Forensic accountant Nell Voss receives a key from a man officially dead before he could have sent it. It opens a municipal archive whose two sets of books are both perfect—and both omit the same living witness.

Nell's investigation crosses print workers, clinic staff, night operators, and families whose safety depends on records remaining incomplete. The player examines evidence, proves contradictions during interviews, assigns custody of dangerous material, and chooses how truth may travel without treating people as disposable links in a chain. Conduct across the case derives one of four investigative routes and gates twelve endings.
